shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure shown frontally/in near-frontal aspect
depiction of adornment or ornament on the body (bracelet/necklace/pendant discs)
incised linear detail across the surface
justification: Both surfaces present a single large anthropomorphic figure occupying nearly the whole field, with incised ornament suggesting jewellery or dress, and in A the winged figure's arm-band and in B the round chest disc are loosely comparable. But A shows a striding profile winged, bird-headed being with two arms holding a bucket and a raised object, rendered with detailed feathered wings and muscled limbs, whereas B is a blocky frontal head-and-torso column with schematic circular and looping motifs and no wings, limbs or held objects — the conventions and the depicted scene are quite different.
